{{Quote|We will fight for you prince!|This commander upon seeing Prince Lee-Char|<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>}}
This '''Mon Calamari''' lived on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and commanded a squadron of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] soldiers that fought the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droids]]. He seemed relieved upon seeing [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] and went into battle alongside him. He was later seen captured by the enemy and while he was transported to a prison camp, he was met by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], who told him and the others not to loose hope.
